NTMP.description: Nodal Temperature (NTMP). Each key is a node number; ITEMS holds one entry per (load case, load group) nodal temperature assigned to that node.

ITEMS.description: Array of nodal temperature entries for this node. One object per load case / load group combination.

ID.description: Serial number of the entry within the node. Optional; if omitted the entry is matched/created by its (LCNAME, GROUP_NAME) combination.

LCNAME.description: Static load case name. Must reference an existing static load case (STLD), otherwise the request is rejected.

GROUP_NAME.description: Load group name. Optional; empty string means no load group. If non-empty it must reference an existing load group.
